description: Defines the SharedFdGatekeeperChannel class, which implements a communication interface for Gatekeeper IPC/RPC calls over file descriptors, including methods for sending requests, responses, and receiving messages.

classes.name: SharedFdGatekeeperChannel
classes.description: A class that facilitates communication with the Gatekeeper service over shared file descriptors, inheriting from GatekeeperChannel.

methods.name: SharedFdGatekeeperChannel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the channel with input and output SharedFDs.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a command and GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a command and GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the channel.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Private method to send a message with command, response flag, and message.
